mechanism_narrative: A rising GDPC1 indicates strong economic growth, which should positively impact corporate earnings and drive up S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: GDPC1 growth is positive but SPX 60-day returns are negative more than 40% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in UNRATE suggests labor market weakness, which could lead to negative S&P 500 returns as consumer spending and business investment decline.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE increases by >0.5pp in one month
failure_condition: UNRATE increases >0.5pp but SPX 20-day returns remain positive more than 50% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: When GDPC1 growth is strong and PAYEMS increases, it indicates a robust economy, leading to higher S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: GDPC1 and PAYEMS both show growth but SPX 60-day returns are negative more than 30% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in FEDFUNDS indicates tighter monetary policy, which could lead to lower S&P 500 returns as borrowing costs rise and consumer spending slows.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS increases by >0.5pp in one month
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS increases >0.5pp but SPX 20-day returns remain positive more than 50% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: A rising INDPRO indicates increased industrial production, which should positively impact corporate revenues and drive up S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: INDPRO growth is positive but SPX 60-day returns are negative more than 40% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in CPIAUCSL suggests higher inflation, which could lead to negative S&P 500 returns as real wages decline and consumer spending slows.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL increases by >4pp in one year
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL increases >4pp but SPX 20-day returns remain positive more than 50% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: When HOUST increases and UNRATE decreases, it indicates a strong housing market and labor market, leading to higher S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: HOUST increases and UNRATE decreases but SPX 60-day returns are negative more than 30% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in RSAFS indicates strong retail sales, which should positively impact corporate revenues and drive up S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS increases by >5% in one month
failure_condition: RSAFS increases >5% but SPX 20-day returns remain negative more than 40% of the time.
